Name: LOOK_AT_PARAM_ST
Description: Look-at control: turns a bone (for example a head or turret) towards the target, with per-axis limits, turning speeds, aim correction and target follow modes.

Fields.Name: Control Bone Name
Fields.Description: Name of the bone the look-at controls.

Fields.Name: Enable Rotation on X-Axis
Fields.Description: If ON, the controlled bone can rotate on the X axis (up/down).

Fields.Name: Enable Rotation on Y-Axis
Fields.Description: If ON, the controlled bone can rotate on the Y axis (left/right).

Fields.Name: Flip Rotation
Fields.Description: If ON, the bone's front is flipped by 180 degrees when rotating.

Fields.Name: Adjust Look-At Direction with Muzzle Position
Fields.Description: If ON, the look-at direction is corrected for the offset between the rotation axis and the muzzle position.

Fields.Name: Upwards Limit Angle
Fields.Description: Upward rotation limit of the look-at, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Downwards Limit Angle
Fields.Description: Downward rotation limit of the look-at, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Maximum Rotation Speed per Second (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: The maximum rotation velocity to apply per second on the X-axis. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Angular Acceleration (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: The angular acceleration on the X-axis to apply. In degrees per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Offset Reference Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly used when correcting the look-at direction for the offset between the rotation axis and the muzzle. -1: the weapon's firing dummy poly.

Fields.Name: Left Limit Angle
Fields.Description: Leftward rotation limit of the look-at, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Right Limit Angle
Fields.Description: Rightward rotation limit of the look-at, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Maximum Rotation Speed per Second (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: The maximum rotation velocity to apply per second on the Y-axis. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Angular Acceleration (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: The angular acceleration on the Y-axis to apply. In degrees per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Target Prediction: Minimum Time
Fields.Description: The look-at aims at the target's position at least this many seconds ahead. Disabled; planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Reference Position Height Offset
Fields.Description: Shifts the reference position used for the direction calculation from the rotation axis by this value on the Y axis.

Fields.Name: Target Prediction: Speed Observation Time
Fields.Description: Time over which the target's speed is observed for target prediction, in seconds. Disabled; planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Target Prediction: Bullet ID
Fields.Description: Bullet used for target prediction. Planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Target Prediction: Maximum Duration
Fields.Description: The look-at aims at the target's position at most this many seconds ahead. Disabled; planned for removal.

Fields.Name: Target Prediction: Weapon Slot Number
Fields.Description: Equipment slot of the weapon (attack action) used for target prediction. -1: default.

Fields.Name: Player Orbit Control Mode
Fields.Description: If ON, uses the control mode for an orbit that follows the player.

Fields.Name: Fade-Out Duration
Fields.Description: Fade-out time when the look-at is disabled, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Lead Shooting Type
Fields.Description: Lead (deflection) shooting type. The bullet param also has a setting for this.

Fields.Name: Follow Look-At Position
Fields.Description: If ON, the look-at target position follows the target using velocity and acceleration.

Fields.Name: Fix the X-Axis Rotation relative to World
Fields.Description: If ON, the X-axis rotation is fixed relative to the world.

Fields.Name: Fix the Y-Axis Rotation relative to World
Fields.Description: If ON, the Y-axis rotation is fixed relative to the world (the character's facing).

Fields.Name: World Fix: Fixed Rotation Offset (X-Axis)
Fields.Description: Offset angle used when the X-axis rotation is fixed relative to the world, in degrees.

Fields.Name: World Fix: Fixed Rotation Offset (Y-Axis)
Fields.Description: Offset angle used when the Y-axis rotation is fixed relative to the world, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Track Target Position: Base Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: The reference dummy polygon ID to use for the track target position mode.

Fields.Name: Track Target Position: Acceleration
Fields.Description: The acceleration towards the target in track target position mode. In metres per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Track Target Position: Deceleration
Fields.Description: The deceleration in directions other than the target in track target position mode. In metres per second ^ 2.

Fields.Name: Track Target Position: Maximum Velocity
Fields.Description: The maximum velocity in track target position mode. In kilometres per hour.

Fields.Name: Rotation %: X-Axis
Fields.Description: Share of the X-axis rotation applied to this bone. 1: faces the target direction. Accumulates from the parent joint.

Fields.Name: Rotation %: Y-Axis
Fields.Description: Share of the Y-axis rotation applied to this bone. 1: faces the target direction. Accumulates from the parent joint.
